general.title: Njiwa WhatsApp
general.description: Check that this shop can reach your customers on WhatsApp.

check.scopeHint: Leave this empty to check the shop-wide settings, which is what a shop with one sales channel wants. Pick a sales channel to check the key and the sending number saved for that channel instead.
check.connectionHint: Lists the WhatsApp numbers your Njiwa account really has and says whether the sending number you chose is one of them. It sends nothing.
check.messageHint: One fixed message to one number you name. Digits only, in full international form, such as 254712345678. On a live key this is a real message that costs real money, so it is limited to five a minute.
check.noAnswer: The request went through but came back with nothing to say. Check var/log for lines from the njiwa channel.
